Game Overview

Meow vs Doge is a cats game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Meow vs Doge doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Meow vs Doge?

Meow vs Doge is a free cats game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Meow vs Doge free to play?

Yes, Meow vs Doge is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
